annotations.exact_quote: Partial Multilabel Learning via Dynamic Fuzzy Aggregations of Multigranularity Features
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确任务为部分多标记学习，需在候选标签中预测多个相关标记，属多标记学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: tackles scenarios where training instances are annotated with a set of candidate labels, only a subset of which is relevant.
annotations.reason_zh: 训练实例仅用候选标签集合标注且只有子集相关，属不精确/候选歧义弱监督，并将其作为核心研究条件。

annotations.exact_quote: the dynamic coarse-granularity graph learns adaptive label representations by identifying feature-aware correlations of labels and suppressing noise.
annotations.reason_zh: 显式通过 feature-aware correlations of labels 建模标签间相关性，以学习自适应标签表示。

annotations.exact_quote: Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets under varying noise conditions demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in partial multilabel classification.
annotations.reason_zh: 候选标签仅子集相关且实验在 varying noise conditions 下评估，方法亦显式抑制噪声，表明监督中的噪声/错误标签是研究条件之一。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要提到动态细/粗粒度图，但未说明其学习或修正的是样本间边/邻接/亲和矩阵，无法确定满足样本间图结构学习定义。
